open_questions: Entry fields 0x134 (loadspec), 0x138 (masterslave), 0x13c (falloff), 0x140 (startdelay) and flag bits 0x144..0x148 are placed by runtime copy order and column-name order, not by a direct column-to-offset observation; confirm against the column setter at 0x080adcc8 (outside this chunk).
Snd_SetFlagByte writes g_085b7655 while Snd_GetFlagByte reads g_085b7654 (adjacent but different). Preserved as observed; confirm whether this is a binary bug or two distinct fields.
Com_MakeSoundAliasesPermanent increments listNode->aliasCount without an explicit zero store; it relies on fn_080ad4c8 returning zero-filled memory (Z_Malloc-like). Confirm the allocator.
SndAlias_MergeSortList with count 0 recurses without a base case (the binary does the same); the caller guards count != 0. Confirm no caller passes an empty list.

All fn_08xxxxxx placeholder signatures in chunk_028_types.h are provisional, taken from call sites. In particular fn_080b7bf8 is used as strcmp on entry source/file/name fields, fn_080ad622/fn_080adcc8 context types, fn_080b7d56 return type, and fn_080d6842/fn_080d6864 (scratch-slot bracketing) are unnamed.

Dvar_ClampValue, Dvar_ValueInDomain and Dvar_DomainText receive value words that are float bit patterns for some types and ints or pointers for others; the chunk keeps them as uint32 words and reinterprets by type, matching the binary.
dvar_color_channel computes 255*x in double before narrowing to float; the binary uses long double then narrows. Results agree for float inputs since the product is exact in double.
Dvar_ParseEnumIndex, Dvar_DomainText type 5 and SndSubtitle_WriteReference rely on integer sentinels (INT_MIN 0x80000000, INT_MAX 0x7fffffff) on raw words; those are preserved, not normalised.
